result.capability_text: Service desk, desktop/device support, Microsoft 365 administration

mandatory_criteria.source_quote: Bidders must hold a valid tax compliance status that remains valid after the closing date.
Bidders must be registered on the Central Supplier Database (CSD) and give their CSD supplier number.
Bidders must be at least 51% Black-owned or hold a B-BBEE Level 1 or Level 2 status.
Bidders must hold professional indemnity insurance of at least R1 million that is still current at the closing date.
Because the supplier will handle our staff's personal information, bidders must provide an information security and POPIA policy.
Bidders must have at least two technicians with current certifications, for example CompTIA A+, Microsoft 365 Certified or ITIL 4 Foundation.

params.text: Service desk, desktop/device support, Microsoft 365 administration

preferred_criteria.source_quote: We would prefer a supplier with proven service desk, desktop and device support, and Microsoft 365 administration capability.
We would prefer at least 3 years of trading and experience with comparable clients of 200 or more users.
We would prefer a team of 8 or more technicians and service desk hours that cover 07:00 to 18:00 on weekdays.
Because of the 4-hour on-site response time, we would prefer a supplier based within about 50 km of our Midrand site.

result.title: Managed IT support & end-user computing: 450 users, 3 sites (Midrand, Centurion, Sandton), 36-month contract, 4-hour on-site response SLA
